rules.statement: An article annexed to a building is considered a fixture and passes to the purchaser on sale of the building if it was intended by the owner to be a permanent part of the structure, even if its attachment is superficial.
rules.supporting_quote: "Thus, a wooden screen standing on its base and only wedged in between two walls so as to be held firmly by them by lateral pressure, but intended by the owner of the building to bet a permanent partition of the main hall of the building into two rooms, is a fixture that passed to the purchaser on a sale of the building"
